force_all_atoms.note: includes fixed subsurface atoms whose DFT reference forces are zeroed; inflated and NOT the standard OC20 force metric

energy_note: energy MAE in reasonable range; centered = 0.9
reference_context: OC20 S2EF leaderboard eqV2-31M ~22 meV/Ang force MAE (free atoms) on val_id; UMA-small here 25.4 meV/Ang MAE — comparable, as expected.
data_provenance: OC20 S2EF val_id (official tar), single 5000-struct chunk streamed (~9MB), 1000 random-sampled (seed 42). val_id_2k split unavailable in fairchem 2.20.
interpretation: UMA-small zero-shot on 1000 OC20 S2EF val_id structures. Force RMSE on FREE atoms is the primary, reference-invariant judge. Naive all-atom force RMSE (430 meV/Ang) is an artifact of OC20's 66% fixed/zeroed-reference atoms, NOT model error — energy MAE is 0.93 meV/atom (near-perfect).
